title: 8-K
主要内容: On September 12, 2016, Intersil Corporation and Renesas Electronics Corporation entered into a merger agreement. Renes, a wholly owned subsidiary of Renesas, will merge with Intersil, with Intersil as the surviving entity. Each outstanding share of Intersil's Class A common stock will be converted into the right to receive $22.50 in cash, excluding shares held by stockholders with valid appraisal rights and shares owned by Intersil, Renesas, and their subsidiaries. Outstanding compensatory options and RSU Awards will be canceled and converted into cash based on the merger consideration and applicable exercise prices. RSU Awards with ongoing performance periods will have their performance periods accelerated, and holders will be deemed fully vested based on actual performance. The merger is subject to shareholder approval, absence of legal barriers, and the expiration of the Hart-Scott-Rodino Act waiting period. A termination fee of $96.5 million is payable to Renesas if the merger is terminated under specific circumstances.
